last_reason.description: RED-UNCHANGED: the working-tree fingerprint equals the last verify's, that verify failed and consecutive_blocks was 0 (Q&A turn or a tree already red before the turn): no rerun, no block (spec.stop_hook.algorithm)

handoff_requested.description: set on NO-PROGRESS when the one continuation is requested; the next Stop clears it and exits 0 without re-running verify (D7 #6)

started_at.description: when this session's counter started (a new start: SessionStart startup or resume, or the first Stop hook of a new session id); the Stop hook of a run with no human adds the HANDOFF line only for a handoff whose created_at is not before it (decisions.accepted[HANDOFFREPORT])

open_question_nudged.description: set when the Stop hook asked once, with no human present, for the open_question handoff of a spec/<slug> branch whose spec.md has an [OPEN] bullet (decisions.accepted[OPENMARK]); a new start resets it

failure_window.description: total_failures of the recent runs; emptied on reset (verify green, decrease, new start, right after NO-PROGRESS)

last_fail_lines.description: the last AGENTIVE_FAIL lines of the last full verify run; the cached NO-PROGRESS / CAP path (unchanged tree, consecutive_blocks > 0) prints them again instead of rerunning verify
